speaker: abel_garnish
text: The fourth act is a report. I will say it before anyone is tempted to be magnificent. The king goes off at Flint a king. He comes on in a London street a prisoner. Between the two, York walks down and tells the unmaking. The house is not let behold it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: That is the book. I am not putting the scene back because it is Thursday and the doors are kind. The Master cut it. The cut is the play they will see.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: I lose a crown in the tiring-house, Will. Every day. Behind a curtain.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It's the law.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: It's a hole. I had rather lose it in front of them, and I am not going to. The hole is what we have.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will not call it a kindness. A kindness would be the page I am not giving thee, and the page stays off the stage.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Then I am a gardener with a laugh, if the hired men are in a laughing mood, and I am not a witness to a deposition. I can play a man who knows something sad about a garden. I cannot play a parliament you have locked in a chest.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: Nobody is asking you to. The Abbot may call it a pageant. The pageant itself is not staged. If you say more than the roll, I will stop you, and I will be right.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: I will say the roll. I have no ambition to invent a crown in a garden. The garden has weeds enough.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: And the Queen, sir. She is in the lengthened gown. On the high line there is a grain in the voice. It was not there at Easter. It is not a break. It is a grain. I can keep a grain. I cannot pretend it is last year's treble.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Keep the grain. Thou art exact when thou art still, and still is what that gown is for. I am not writing thee a higher note to prove a point the throat has already answered.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: I heard the grain on the last time through. I looked up, and I looked down again, which is as much comment as a lutenist should spend on another man's breath. Do not make him force it. Forced, it will lie.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: I will not force it, sir. The gown does not show its hem from the door. We settled that. I am asking about the note, and the note I can manage if no one asks me to be eleven.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: No one is asking thee to be eleven. Be the Queen you have become. The grain is honest. Honesty will do, on a Thursday, better than a trick.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: The throne stays empty of the scene we cut. I may lay the glass on the seat until I must sit. I am not offering a reason. I am offering a habit, and a habit is not a restoration.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The habit is thine until half past one. After that the glass has no business in a play that only reports the unmaking. I will say so once, and Abel will do the locking, and I will not make a speech about a property.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: I will lock it when the hour says lock it. Not in this rehearsal. A rehearsal may look at a thing. A performance may not smuggle it back into a cut. Those are different sins, and I know which one I am paid to prevent.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Then we play the wound as a wound. I can give the jig a tune when Kemp wants a tune. I cannot give the fourth act a spectacle the book refused.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Kemp is not in this act. He is in the dance after, and the dance is his wealth. Let him be wealthy later. This hour is a man sitting down to tell sad stories, and a crown that changes heads while a bishop talks.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: For Gods sake let vs sit vpon the ground. That one is thine, and it is in the book, and it does not require the page we cut. Say the stories. Do not stage the one the Abbot is sorry they missed.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: I can sit. I have been sitting, in my mind, since the yard was empty. An empty yard is a good teacher of quiet. A full one will have to learn it from the line.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: And if they laugh at the gardener, let them. A laugh in the garden is not a deposition. I will not build a second play out of their good humour.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: You will not. I have the plot. The plot has no parliament on it. Go and eat, those of you who can. Will, your Gaunt is the second act, and then you are a door. Remember which you are. A man cannot be both the dead and the witness in the same breath.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I remember. Dead by the middle of the second act. The door after. I will not try to watch myself die. The house may have that pleasure without my help.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: I will be exact, sir. And still. And a little grain, and no apology for it.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: No apology. Apologies are audible. The grain can be a fact.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Then we are set. Thou hast thy law, Will, and I have my hole, and Abel has the key he has not yet turned. God keep us till the doors. After the doors, keep thy mouth for Gaunt and not for argument.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The mouth is already bargained for. God keep thee. I am going to be quiet until the line needs me, which is more religion than the morning required.
